activation: No billable execution or live study authorized by this contract.

proposed_provider.name: MeteredReflectionProvider
proposed_provider.signature: decide(task: Task, state: ReflectionState, *, timeout: float) -> Decision
proposed_provider.usage_semantics: usage is the current decide-call snapshot; budget_state.usage is cumulative per run; report consumes cumulative totals without re-adding snapshots

proposed_limits.max_requests: required finite exact integer >= 0; zero denies dispatch
proposed_limits.per_request_max_output_tokens: required finite exact integer >= local minimum_output_allowance

proposed_report.name: MeteredReflectionReport
proposed_report.usage_balance: cumulative model_usage.calls equals charged request_attempts; token totals remain null if any constituent usage is unknown

offline_gates.requirement: Serialize only original Task and strict ReflectionState fields; reject oracle/private/canary extras.
Keep exact mock provider gate, zero-usage ReflectionReport, Mode and historical runner defaults unchanged.
Reset usage, request attempts, diagnostics and context at each new run; no remote conversation replay.
Finite exact-integer max_requests and positive remaining deadline/output allowance checked before dispatch.
Charge each dispatch-boundary attempt once, including transport errors/timeouts; no refunds or retries.
Execution and corrective calls share request/token/output/cost ledgers and action/decision/time caps.
Exactly one validated Decision; reject multiple/unknown calls, malformed or unauthorized targets/statuses.
Record available usage once before status/structured-output parsing; no missing-usage zero substitution.
Missing token usage or unknown cost under active cost limit stops further dispatch and tool execution.
Known response overshoot retains usage and stops before acting on the returned decision.
Refusal, incomplete response, invalid output and transport error preserve sanitized primary provider failure.
After-call deadline check prevents a late action or finish claim.
Original-task authorization and fresh-read/idempotent repeated-write guards apply to every proposal.
Persist bounded normalized context, phase/decision/request/usage events and report; no keys, raw SDK errors or private reasoning.
Separate metered report preserves original/final claims, verified_success null and known/unknown usage.
Reconcile dispatched requests/usage/phase/counters/claims without provider, tool or oracle execution.
All contract tests inject fake transports; fail if a real client/network dispatch is constructed.
No CLI/live study wiring until offline contract, adapter, engine/replay and prospective execution gates pass.

implementation_sequence: strict boundary and request-accounting types with offline tests
injected metered adapter with fake-transport tests
separate metered engine/report and saved-trace reconciler
prospective live study/configuration and spending/accounting review
limitations: Contract only: no new provider, report, engine, CLI or study is implemented.
Observed token/cost limits can overshoot after a response; input work and billing may be unknown.
No LLM-quality, stochastic, causal, equal-information or dollar-parity result is established.
